text:
```yaml
name: Close stale issues

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
      pull-requests: none
    steps:
      - uses: actions/stale@v9
        with:
          # Only process issues, not pull requests
          days-before-stale: 180
          days-before-close: 0
          stale-issue-label: stale
          exempt-issue-labels: pinned,security,working in progress,to be discussed,feature request
          operations-per-run: 30
          stale-issue-message: >
            This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has been open for 6 months with no activity.
            It will be closed immediately. If you believe this issue is still relevant, please reopen it or create a new issue.
            Thank you for your contributions.
          close-issue-message: >
            This issue has been automatically closed because it has been open for 6 months with no activity.
            If you believe this issue is still relevant, please reopen it or create a new issue.
            Thank you for your contributions.
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
